# FreeSound <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FreeSound:Void sound:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | In | Int32 | required | A handle from [LoadSound](LoadSound) or [Load3DSound](Load3DSound). |

## Description

Throws a loaded sound away and frees its memory. Channels that are playing this sound are stopped. Sounds are freed when the program ends anyway, so this is for programs that load a lot of sounds, for example one set for each level.

## Differences

* FreeSound with a handle that was freed already, or with 0, is ignored. A program compiled with `-d` stops with an error message instead, see [Debug-Handle-Checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
PlaySound snd
Delay 600
FreeSound snd
```
